facts.statement: The species was originally named and described by Zhang Yihun in 1988.
facts.quote: In 1988 Zhang Yihun named and described the type species Protognathus oxyodon.

facts.statement: The original generic name Protognathus was preoccupied by a beetle genus, leading to its renaming.
facts.quote: However, the generic name was preoccupied, already in use, by a genus of carabid beetle, Protognathus (Basilewsky, 1950) which is considered a synonym of Pseudognathaphanus (Schauberger, 1932).

facts.statement: George Olshevsky renamed the species Protognathosaurus oxyodon in 1991.
facts.quote: The species was therefore renamed into the combinatio nova Protognathosaurus oxyodon by George Olshevsky in 1991.

facts.statement: The fossil fragment includes the front left dentary showing eighteen tooth positions with sharp replacement teeth.
facts.quote: The fragment consists of the front left dentary and shows eighteen tooth positions, some still containing sharp replacement teeth, after which the genus was named.

facts.statement: Protognathosaurus is classified within the suborder Sauropoda.
The genus belongs to the unranked family Eusauropoda.
Protognathosaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 165 to 160 million years ago, between the Bathonian and Callovian stages.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 165 a 160 millones de años, entre el Bathoniense y el Calloviense

facts.statement: The time range for the genus is estimated from the Bajocian to the Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Protognathosaurus is placed in the parent group Cetiosauridae.

rejected.statement: Protognathosaurus is a genus of herbivorous sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic of Sichuan, China.
rejected.quote: Protognathosaurus (meaning "early jaw lizard") is a genus of herbivorous sauropod dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic Lower Shaximiao Formation in Sichuan, present-day China.

rejected.statement: The animal is known only from a fragmentary lower jaw found in the Bathonian-Callovian layers of the Shaximiao Formation.
rejected.quote: Protognathosaurus is known only from a fragmentary lower jaw, holotype CV 00732 (= ChM V732) found in a layer of the Shaximiao Formation dating from the Bathonian-Callovian.
